title: Coupler
text: Model ideal frequency-independent couplers with S-parameters, {Select component} sets Coupler type Directional; {Coupling (dB)} sets the fraction of input signal power coupled to output, {Directivity (dB)} sets the ratio of power at coupled port to power at isolated port, {Insertion loss (dB)} sets the loss of signal power between input and output ports, {Return loss (dB)} sets the loss of signal power due to impedance mismatch, {Power transmission coefficient} sets the transmitted signal power, {Reference impedances (Ohm)} sets the reference impedance of coupler and {Ground and hide negative terminals} sets the ground RF circuit terminals. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Select component
params.values: Coupler type Directional coupler (default) | Coupler symmetrical | Coupler antisymmetrical | Hybrid quadrature (90 deg) | Hybrid rat-race | Magic tee

params.name: Coupling (dB)
params.values: Fraction of input signal power coupled to output port 0 (default) | nonnegative and real scalar

params.name: Directivity (dB)
params.values: Ratio of power at coupled port to power at isolated port inf (default) | nonnegative and real scalar

params.name: Insertion loss (dB)
params.values: Loss of signal power between input and output ports inf (default) | nonnegative and real scalar

params.name: Return loss (dB)
params.values: Loss of signal power due to impedance mismatch inf (default) | nonnegative and real scalar

params.name: Reference impedances (Ohm)
params.values: Reference impedance of coupler 50 (default) | positive scalar | positive three-tuple vector

params.name: Ground and hide negative terminals
params.values: Ground RF circuit terminals on (default) | off
